description: Parameters for the Task tool: delegate a self-contained task to a sub-agent, optionally in the background. Design only; implementation is post-v0.3.0.

description.description: Short (3-5 word) label for the task, shown in the UI task list.

model.description: Model override for this sub-agent. Must end with ':free'; empty or 'inherit' keeps the parent model.

prompt.description: The full, self-contained instruction for the sub-agent.

run_in_background.description: If true, return immediately with a task_id; use TaskResult to collect the result later.

subagent_type.description: Which sub-agent to run. explore = read-only, code = read+write, general = inherit parent tool set.

title: Task tool parameters (P5 design, 2026-10-17)
